key: TAKA: How did this car even get all the way over here?
en: TAKA: How did this car even get all the way over here?
ja: タカ: この車両　どうやって　こんなとこまで　来たんでしょう?

key: How did any of these trains even get where they are?
en: How did any of these trains even get where they are?
ja: そもそも　この列車たち　どうやって　今の場所に　たどり着いたんでしょう?
それに　僕は　どうやって――
僕も　ただの　別の列車　なのかも。

key: An especially fierce sandstorm seems to be raging on ahead...
en: An especially fierce sandstorm seems to be raging on ahead...
ja: 先のほうで　特に　激しい砂嵐が　吹き荒れているようだ……

key: Going farther by foot would be unsafe.
en: Going farther by foot would be unsafe.
ja: このまま　徒歩で　進むのは　危険だ。

key: TAKA: \PN, I don't think we can safely go further than this...
en: TAKA: \PN, I don't think we can safely go further than this...
ja: タカ: \PN　これ以上は　安全に　進めないと　思います……

key: That sandstorm out there looks like a bad time waiting to happen, and I don't think it's gonna blow over soon.
en: That sandstorm out there looks like a bad time waiting to happen, and I don't think it's gonna blow over soon.
ja: あの砂嵐　ろくなことに　ならなさそうですし　すぐに　収まりそうにも　ありません。
とりあえず　戻りましょう。

key: Oh-ho! So you've found my secret training spot!
en: Oh-ho! So you've found my secret training spot!
ja: おおっと! おれの秘密の　トレーニングスポットを　見つけたか!

key: You are quite strong! That battle was off the rails!
en: You are quite strong! That battle was off the rails!
ja: マキシマス: なかなか　強いな! あのバトルは　まさに　脱線もの　だったぜ!

key: Perhaps this spot isn't serving me. I'll have to make tracks soon.
en: Perhaps this spot isn't serving me. I'll have to make tracks soon.
ja: ここも　もう　役に立たなくなったかもな。そろそろ　線路を　変えないと。
